assembly.type: ราวกันตก ลูกกรงแนวตั้ง (BH035)
assembly.joints: Posts at 1200 centres: end posts U7280 (38 face), intermediate posts U7281 (45, H section). Top: horizontal U7280 rail capped by handrail BH035 running over the posts. Upper and lower horizontal rails U7280 between posts; balusters (labelled U276) between the rails, slot closed by U7218. Post base: plate + cover (ฝาครอบขา) 22 high, anchor bolt into slab (ตัวยึดขา).
assembly.clearances_mm: post spacing 1200 c/c (printed); rail depth 60; post base cover 22
assembly.notes: No cut formulas or baluster spacing printed; baluster count per 1200 bay not dimensioned.
